## The complete document management solutions

From creation to signature to payment, PandaDoc is a 360-degree document management solution that
helps your teams get more done, faster.

[Request a demo][103]
Benefits
Create

Easily generate custom agreements tailored to your audience and workflow with our drag-and-drop
editor.

[Smart content][104]
Collaborate

With PandaDoc, everyone’s eyes are on the same document for real-time redlining, comments,
approvals, and more.

[Workspaces][105][Rooms][106]
Automate

PandaDoc's CRM integrations, embeddable API, and automation features speed up your workflows while
eliminating errors and repetitive tasks.

[CRM integration][107][API][108]
Sign

Not only can you capture signatures, but decide signing order, verify the identity of recipients,
set signing groups, and even notarize documents.

[Signing order][109][eSignature][110]
Analyze

PandaDoc records an audit trail for every document, reports user activity, and tracks document
metrics, too.

[Document tracking][111][Audit trail][112]
Get paid

Easily embed trusted payment gateways directly into bills and invoices so customers can pay with
just a few clicks.

[Payments][113]

## Safe, secure, and
## legally binding

PandaDoc is E-SIGN, UETA, HIPAA compliant, and SOC 2 certified, offering secure electronic
signatures. It also provides SSO and a robust API for granular document and workspace permissions.

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.

## What You Will Master in ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification

Cybersecurity isn’t just a career path anymore, it’s a frontline battle. With ACSMI’s

### You won’t just know cybersecurity, you’ll command it.

[icon]

Lead cyber investigations, recover breached systems, and present bulletproof forensic evidence —
just like top SOCs worldwide.

#### Information Security and Data Protection

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

##### Cross-Border Paperless Trade Database

Accelerating progress towards trade/ digitalization through knowledge sharing

[More][25]

Previous Next

#### Latest Projects

[UNECE Blockchain Pilot for Traceability and Transparency in Textile and Cotton Supply Chains][26]

A global UN initiative using blockchain technology and DNA markers to enable end-to-end traceability
of textile products from cotton field to retail shelf, verifying sustainability claims across value
chains.

[Port-to-Port Exchange Project: Caspian Corridor][27]

Digital data exchange initiative between Caspian Sea ports (Baku, Aktau, Turkmenbashi) to harmonize
container movement and logistics information using UN/CEFACT standards and Multimodal Transport
Reference Data Model.

[Regional Platform of the National Trade Facilitation Committees (NTFCs) in Central Asia][28]

The Regional Platform of NTFCs in Central Asia brings together representatives from Kazakhstan,
Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan twice annually to coordinate trade facilitation
reforms and promote paperless trade across the region.

#### Latest Services

[Wave BL Platform - Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL) Blockchain Software][29]

WaveBL is a blockchain-based platform that digitalizes the bill of lading, enabling secure, instant
issuance, transfer, and surrender of electronic bills of lading (eBLs) and related trade documents.

[Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) - Global LEI System][30]

GLEIF manages the Global LEI System, providing unique 20-character identifiers for legal entities
engaged in financial transactions, enabling transparent entity identification worldwide.

[Kyrgyzstan Electronic Invoice Note System (ETTN)][31]

The ETTN is a centralized electronic invoicing platform operated by the State Tax Service enabling
businesses to create, digitally sign, validate and exchange invoices in real-time for B2B
transactions in Kyrgyzstan and within EAEU.

#### Acknowledgements

Maintenance of this database is supported by financial and human resources provided by the
Governments of China, France and the Republic of Korea. Its launch was made possible by a project
funded by the Republic of Korea entitled “Capacity Building on Trade Facilitation and the
Asia-Pacific Trade Agreement (APTA) Promotion to Strengthen Intra-regional Cooperation” (Phases II
and III), a project funded by China entitled “Facilitating Cross-Border Paperless Trade for Regional
Integration and Sustainable Development - Phase II”, as well as a UN Development Account project
“Transport and trade connectivity in the age of pandemics: contactless, seamless and collaborative
UN solutions”. The underlying content and online submission forms benefited from inputs by UNNExT
experts and advisory groups, as well as reviews by the technical and legal working groups of the
Interim Intergovernmental Steering Group for Cross-Border Paperless Trade Facilitation in Asia and
the Pacific in 2019/2020.

[[UN ESCAP Footer Logo White]][32]

#### Contact

**The United Nations Building**
Rajadamnern Nok Avenue
Bangkok 10200
Thailand

Telephone (66-2) 288-1234

Fax (66-2) 288-1000

#### Latest Projects

[UNECE Blockchain Pilot for Traceability and Transparency in Textile and Cotton Supply Chains][26]

A global UN initiative using blockchain technology and DNA markers to enable end-to-end traceability
of textile products from cotton field to retail shelf, verifying sustainability claims across value
chains.

[Port-to-Port Exchange Project: Caspian Corridor][27]

Digital data exchange initiative between Caspian Sea ports (Baku, Aktau, Turkmenbashi) to harmonize
container movement and logistics information using UN/CEFACT standards and Multimodal Transport
Reference Data Model.

[Regional Platform of the National Trade Facilitation Committees (NTFCs) in Central Asia][28]

The Regional Platform of NTFCs in Central Asia brings together representatives from Kazakhstan,
Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan twice annually to coordinate trade facilitation
reforms and promote paperless trade across the region.

#### Latest Services

[Wave BL Platform - Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL) Blockchain Software][29]

WaveBL is a blockchain-based platform that digitalizes the bill of lading, enabling secure, instant
issuance, transfer, and surrender of electronic bills of lading (eBLs) and related trade documents.

[Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) - Global LEI System][30]

GLEIF manages the Global LEI System, providing unique 20-character identifiers for legal entities
engaged in financial transactions, enabling transparent entity identification worldwide.

[Kyrgyzstan Electronic Invoice Note System (ETTN)][31]

The ETTN is a centralized electronic invoicing platform operated by the State Tax Service enabling
businesses to create, digitally sign, validate and exchange invoices in real-time for B2B
transactions in Kyrgyzstan and within EAEU.

UN solutions”. The underlying content and online submission forms benefited from inputs by UNNExT
experts and advisory groups, as well as reviews by the technical and legal working groups of the
Interim Intergovernmental Steering Group for Cross-Border Paperless Trade Facilitation in Asia and

Trust

### Improve security

All documents are encrypted using RSA 256 encryption and the connection to the Diliforce service is
always encrypted using Symantec SHA 256 RSA SSL with extended validation. Microsoft Cloud meets key
international and industry-specific compliance standards, such as ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27018,
FedRAMP, and SOC 1 and SOC 2. They also meet regional and country-specific standards and contractual
commitments, including the EU Model Clauses, UK G-Cloud, Singapore MTCS, and Australia CCSL (IRAP).
All data is stored across multiple redundant hardware clusters and is geo-replicated to another
Azure datacenter to ensure continuity of services.

Diliforce makes storing documents easier than ever. If the document is in an email, all you need to

drag and drop multiple files simultaneously into the system. Use our AI-powered metadata extraction
tool to easily add tags, crucial dates and counterparties to your contracts in order to turn them
into intelligent documents that will drive your business.

need—our system finds it anywhere. Filter by tags and fields, save queries for quick reports, and
enjoy search that’s faster, sharper, and more intuitive.

## Enhance your governance workflow

Transform your governance processes with our comprehensive digital platform designed to support
growth and compliance.

[Component 1 (3)]
Trust

### Improve security

All documents are encrypted using RSA 256 encryption and the connection to the Diliforce service is
always encrypted using Symantec SHA 256 RSA SSL with extended validation. Microsoft Cloud meets key
international and industry-specific compliance standards, such as ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27018,
FedRAMP, and SOC 1 and SOC 2. They also meet regional and country-specific standards and contractual
commitments, including the EU Model Clauses, UK G-Cloud, Singapore MTCS, and Australia CCSL (IRAP).
All data is stored across multiple redundant hardware clusters and is geo-replicated to another
Azure datacenter to ensure continuity of services.

[ Read More about Azure Security ][58]
[Component 1 (4)]
Organization

### Remember key dates

Diliforce brings your contracts to life. You can set automated email-reminders to all the people in
your team. Never miss an important date or deadline again! Contract Calendar -page shows you what's
going on in your contract database and the Contract Timeline keeps you up to date on contract
history. Our Microsoft 365 Outlook calendar integration lets you see all the important reminders
directly in the calendar you love to use.

[Group 2 (1)]
Efficiency

### Import effortlessly

Diliforce makes storing documents easier than ever. If the document is in an email, all you need to
do is to forward the email to Diliforce - we will even store the email itself as a PDF. You can also
drag and drop multiple files simultaneously into the system. Use our AI-powered metadata extraction
tool to easily add tags, crucial dates and counterparties to your contracts in order to turn them
into intelligent documents that will drive your business.

[Component 1 (6)]
AI Technology

### Instant insights

Unlock the full value of your documents with AI-powered analysis, automated metadata extraction,
concise summaries, multilingual translation, and tailored clause/template drafting—securely inside
Diliforce. Go beyond folders with metadata-driven views and AI-powered OCR. Just type what you
need—our system finds it anywhere. Filter by tags and fields, save queries for quick reports, and
enjoy search that’s faster, sharper, and more intuitive.

## Frequently asked

Does eSignatures.com issue legally binding contracts?

Yes. Contracts issued with eSignatures.com are legally binding for almost all common business and
personal transactions in most countries. eSignatures.com complies with the requirements of the U.S.
ESIGN Act, UETA, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, the European Union eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Signature
level, not Advanced or Qualified), the Canadian UECA, the UK eIDAS and ECA, the Australian
Electronic Transactions Act (ETA), the New Zealand Electronic Transactions Act (ETA), and the South
African ECTA. eSignatures.com is also designed to support GDPR-compliant processing and storage of
personal data.

How does eSignatures.com handle security and privacy?

eSignatures.com is designed for serious security and privacy without unnecessary complexity. All
contracts include tamper-evident audit trails, data is handled under ISO 27001-based security
practices, and personal data is processed in line with GDPR principles. eSignatures.com does not
sell contract data to third parties, and the focus is on keeping documents safe, traceable and easy
to access when needed.

How do recipients sign documents with eSignatures.com?

Recipients receive a unique link by email or SMS. They tap the link, review the contract in a clean,
mobile-friendly layout, fill in any required fields, and tap “Sign” to complete the process. Once
all required parties have signed, everyone receives a finalised copy and the full audit trail is
stored with the contract.

Does eSignatures.com work on mobile devices?

Yes. eSignatures.com is designed to be mobile-first. Contracts are displayed as responsive, readable
pages instead of static PDFs, so text is easy to read, fields are easy to tap, and signers do not
need to pinch-zoom or scroll awkwardly. This makes the signing process faster and clearer for both
customers and staff, especially when most people sign on their phones.

Does eSignatures.com use PDF files to sign contracts?

No. eSignatures.com deliberately avoids using rigid PDF files for the signing experience. Instead,
contracts are created as editable, mobile-friendly templates that adapt to different screen sizes.
This makes documents easier to read, reduces errors, and avoids many of the common mobile issues
associated with traditional PDF forms.

Is eSignatures.com suitable for high-volume teams?

Yes. eSignatures.com is built for teams that send contracts every day, from dozens up to thousands
per month. The dashboard, templates and Contract Links are designed to stay fast and usable at
scale, so operations, insurance, health and SaaS teams can keep sending and tracking large volumes
of contracts without adding unnecessary complexity.

How can I tell the status of a document sent for signing through eSignatures.com?

Every contract appears in a real-time dashboard where you can see whether it has been sent, viewed,
signed, or completed. You can open any contract to review the full audit trail of the signing
process, adjust content or recipient details when needed, and send reminders to recipients.

Does eSignatures.com have an API and integrations?

Yes. eSignatures.com provides a clean REST API for embedding signing into your own product, along
with webhooks for tracking status changes such as “sent”, “viewed”, and “signed”. eSignatures.com
also connects to automation tools like Zapier, so you can trigger sending, tracking, and storage of
signed documents without building everything from scratch. The same transparent, pay-per-use pricing
applies whether you send via the dashboard, API or automations.

Do I need a sales call or long contract to get started?

No. You can create an account, test with sample contracts, and start sending real documents without
talking to a sales team or signing a long-term contract. eSignatures.com uses transparent,
pay-per-use pricing, so you only pay for the contracts you send, and you can scale up or down at any
time without changing plans or negotiating new tiers.

How does pricing work, including the API?

Pricing is simple and usage-based. You pay a flat fee per contract sent, whether you use the
dashboard, the API, or automations, and there are no monthly subscription fees or setup charges.
Optional SMS delivery is charged separately per message. For current rates and currency options, see
the Pricing page.

What languages does eSignatures.com support?

eSignatures.com supports signing in multiple languages and handles most Unicode character sets
throughout the document flow. Currently supported interface languages include: Chinese (simplified),
Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, English (UK), Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian,
Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian,
Spanish, Swedish, Vietnamese

Can I use my own branding?

Yes. eSignatures.com allows you to use your own logo and customise key parts of the experience so
that customers see your brand, not ours. Signature requests and notification emails can be branded
with your company identity to keep the signing process consistent with your existing customer
journey.

How does eSignatures.com compare to DocuSign?

DocuSign is a large enterprise platform with broad feature sets and subscription tiers.
eSignatures.com focuses on a simpler, mobile-first signing experience, a clean developer-friendly
API, and transparent pay-per-use pricing, designed for teams that send documents regularly and want
less complexity. For a detailed breakdown see the [DocuSign alternatives page][30]

What is an electronic signature?

An electronic signature is an electronic sound, symbol, or process, attached to or logically
associated with a contract or record, that a person uses with the intent to sign. In practice,
electronic signatures are used every day for offer letters, sales contracts, permission slips,
rental and lease agreements, liability waivers, financial documents, and many other agreements. When
used correctly, they are legally binding in most business and personal transactions around the
world.

## Minutiae

### Legal validity worldwide

Contracts signed on eSignatures.com are legally binding under the US ESIGN Act (2000) and UETA,
eIDAS in the EU and UK, Canada’s UECA, Australia’s and New Zealand’s Electronic Transactions Acts,
and South Africa’s ECTA. eSignatures.com provides simple electronic signatures under eIDAS, which
are valid for almost any business or personal transaction; advanced and qualified signatures are not
offered. Every contract records who signed, when, where and how, and the completed document is
protected against modification in the cloud.

### Audit trail and evidence

Each signed contract is delivered as a single PDF containing the full electronic signature record:
signer name, signing date, IP address, delivery method, verification steps completed, and every
field the signer filled in. PDF/A output is available for long-term, court-submittable archiving,
and signed contracts are retained for a mandatory three years in line with recordkeeping
requirements.

### How signers are verified

Does eSignatures.com issue legally binding contracts?

Yes. Contracts issued with eSignatures.com are legally binding for almost all common business and
personal transactions in most countries. eSignatures.com complies with the requirements of the U.S.
ESIGN Act, UETA, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, the European Union eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Signature
level, not Advanced or Qualified), the Canadian UECA, the UK eIDAS and ECA, the Australian
Electronic Transactions Act (ETA), the New Zealand Electronic Transactions Act (ETA), and the South
African ECTA. eSignatures.com is also designed to support GDPR-compliant processing and storage of
personal data.

How does eSignatures.com handle security and privacy?

eSignatures.com is designed for serious security and privacy without unnecessary complexity. All
contracts include tamper-evident audit trails, data is handled under ISO 27001-based security
practices, and personal data is processed in line with GDPR principles. eSignatures.com does not
sell contract data to third parties, and the focus is on keeping documents safe, traceable and easy
to access when needed.

How do recipients sign documents with eSignatures.com?

Recipients receive a unique link by email or SMS. They tap the link, review the contract in a clean,
mobile-friendly layout, fill in any required fields, and tap “Sign” to complete the process. Once
all required parties have signed, everyone receives a finalised copy and the full audit trail is
stored with the contract.

Does eSignatures.com work on mobile devices?

Yes. eSignatures.com is designed to be mobile-first. Contracts are displayed as responsive, readable
pages instead of static PDFs, so text is easy to read, fields are easy to tap, and signers do not
need to pinch-zoom or scroll awkwardly. This makes the signing process faster and clearer for both
customers and staff, especially when most people sign on their phones.

Does eSignatures.com use PDF files to sign contracts?

No. eSignatures.com deliberately avoids using rigid PDF files for the signing experience. Instead,
contracts are created as editable, mobile-friendly templates that adapt to different screen sizes.
This makes documents easier to read, reduces errors, and avoids many of the common mobile issues
associated with traditional PDF forms.

Is eSignatures.com suitable for high-volume teams?

Yes. eSignatures.com is built for teams that send contracts every day, from dozens up to thousands
per month. The dashboard, templates and Contract Links are designed to stay fast and usable at
scale, so operations, insurance, health and SaaS teams can keep sending and tracking large volumes
of contracts without adding unnecessary complexity.

How can I tell the status of a document sent for signing through eSignatures.com?

Every contract appears in a real-time dashboard where you can see whether it has been sent, viewed,
signed, or completed. You can open any contract to review the full audit trail of the signing
process, adjust content or recipient details when needed, and send reminders to recipients.

Does eSignatures.com have an API and integrations?

Yes. eSignatures.com provides a clean REST API for embedding signing into your own product, along
with webhooks for tracking status changes such as “sent”, “viewed”, and “signed”. eSignatures.com
also connects to automation tools like Zapier, so you can trigger sending, tracking, and storage of
signed documents without building everything from scratch. The same transparent, pay-per-use pricing
applies whether you send via the dashboard, API or automations.

Do I need a sales call or long contract to get started?

No. You can create an account, test with sample contracts, and start sending real documents without
talking to a sales team or signing a long-term contract. eSignatures.com uses transparent,
pay-per-use pricing, so you only pay for the contracts you send, and you can scale up or down at any
time without changing plans or negotiating new tiers.

How does pricing work, including the API?

Pricing is simple and usage-based. You pay a flat fee per contract sent, whether you use the
dashboard, the API, or automations, and there are no monthly subscription fees or setup charges.
Optional SMS delivery is charged separately per message. For current rates and currency options, see
the Pricing page.

What languages does eSignatures.com support?

eSignatures.com supports signing in multiple languages and handles most Unicode character sets
throughout the document flow. Currently supported interface languages include: Chinese (simplified),
Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, English (UK), Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian,
Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian,
Spanish, Swedish, Vietnamese

Can I use my own branding?

Yes. eSignatures.com allows you to use your own logo and customise key parts of the experience so
that customers see your brand, not ours. Signature requests and notification emails can be branded
with your company identity to keep the signing process consistent with your existing customer
journey.

How does eSignatures.com compare to DocuSign?

DocuSign is a large enterprise platform with broad feature sets and subscription tiers.
eSignatures.com focuses on a simpler, mobile-first signing experience, a clean developer-friendly
API, and transparent pay-per-use pricing, designed for teams that send documents regularly and want
less complexity. For a detailed breakdown see the [DocuSign alternatives page][30]

What is an electronic signature?

An electronic signature is an electronic sound, symbol, or process, attached to or logically
associated with a contract or record, that a person uses with the intent to sign. In practice,
electronic signatures are used every day for offer letters, sales contracts, permission slips,
rental and lease agreements, liability waivers, financial documents, and many other agreements. When
used correctly, they are legally binding in most business and personal transactions around the
world.

Contracts signed on eSignatures.com are legally binding under the US ESIGN Act (2000) and UETA,

and South Africa’s ECTA. eSignatures.com provides simple electronic signatures under eIDAS, which
are valid for almost any business or personal transaction; advanced and qualified signatures are not
offered. Every contract records who signed, when, where and how, and the completed document is
protected against modification in the cloud.

### Audit trail and evidence

Each signed contract is delivered as a single PDF containing the full electronic signature record:

### How does Foxit PDF Editor compare to Adobe Acrobat?

[Foxit PDF Editor][53] is often chosen as a cost-effective, easy-to-use alternative to Adobe
Acrobat. Users love its clean, intuitive layout and features that cover all the basics—and then
some—without the Adobe price tag. Many users find Foxit’s customer support more responsive, too,
which is always a plus!

### What platforms are Foxit products available on?

Foxit’s PDF software tools are available on Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android, so you can work from
just about any device. We even offer a browser-based version, so all you ever need is an internet
connection to access your PDFs.

### Is Foxit secure for handling sensitive documents?

Absolutely! Foxit is committed to keeping your documents safe. We use top-notch security measures
like passwords, encryption, and secure deletion to protect your information. You can rest easy
knowing your sensitive files are in good hands.

### Can I collaborate with others using Foxit PDF solutions?

Definitely! Foxit’s PDF software makes it super easy to work with your team. You can review,
comment, and annotate documents in real time and even get quick digital signatures with Foxit eSign.
No more juggling multiple versions or waiting around for approvals.

### What kind of licensing options does Foxit offer for organizations?

Foxit offers flexible licensing options to fit your organization's specific needs. Whether you're a
small team or a large enterprise, Foxit has you covered. You can choose between subscription-based
plans or one-time purchases. Plus, we offer volume discounts for larger teams, making it easy to
find a cost-effective solution. Explore [volume licensing options][54].

### Can Foxit integrate with other tools or software?

Yes! Foxit plays well with others, integrating smoothly with popular tools like Microsoft Office
365, Google Drive, and Salesforce. This means you can easily work with your PDFs right within your
favorite apps, saving you time and hassle.

### Does Foxit offer cloud-based PDF solutions?

Yes, Foxit has cloud-based PDF software solutions, like Foxit PDF Editor and Foxit eSign. You can
create, store, edit, and share PDFs in the cloud, plus collaborate in real time—all without needing
to download extra software.

### Does Foxit support batch processing of documents?

It does! With Foxit PDF Editor, you can batch-process tasks like converting, merging, or compressing
multiple PDFs at once. This feature is particularly useful for businesses with lots of documents,
helping to complete tasks efficiently and save time.

### Does Foxit support OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology?

Yes, Foxit’s OCR feature lets you turn scanned images and PDFs into searchable, editable documents.
It’s great for keeping digital records of paper documents, so you can find what you need with just a
quick search.

Excellent service: personalised and trustworthy

At inSign, we focus on real people rather than anonymous processes. Your personal point of contact

## **FAQ** – Key issues about our digital signature

Are inSign electronic signatures legally compliant?

The electronic signature can be used for legal purposes in all European Union countries and cannot
be rejected as evidence. inSign supports the [signature types][62] simple electronic signature
(SES), advanced electronic signature (AES) and qualfied electronic signature (QES) in accordance
with both eIDAS and ZertES.

[More about legal and data protection][63]

What documents can be signed with inSign?

You can sign and fill in any kind of [PDF documents ][64]with our signature software. Whether
invoices, order confirmations or contracts – signing is easy thanks to inSign. With the inSign Word
Add-in, [ Word documents][65] can also be automatically converted into a PDF, making it very easy to
sign them electronically. The same is possible with the Excel add-in for Excel documents.

[Further use cases][66]

Can you sign directly on the computer?

Yes, with inSign signatures be made on the computer by means of keyboard input or qualified
certificate (QES).
For the handwritten electronic signature, a touch-sensitive screen (smartphone, tablet, etc.) is
required. If a computer does not have a touch screen, the signature process can be redirected to a
smartphone, for example.

[All about features and advantages of inSign][67]

Why can I use the electronic signature without worries?

inSign creates an audit report (transaction log) of the complete signature workflow. This, together
with the information depending on the signature method, serves as proof in the event of any
disputes. The evidential value of the biometric data in the handwritten signature of inSign was
examined by an qualified handwriting expert and positively assessed in an expert opinion. All inSign
signatures are GDPR and eIDAS compliant and 100% secure.

[More about advanced and qualified signature][68]

How does inSign ensure data sovereignty?
With the inSign electronic signature software, companies retain full control over their data at all
times. inSign is a German company and uses German subcontractors. Data processing takes place in
Germany in data centres operated by German companies. inSign guarantees full compliance with the
GDPR, meaning that the high European data protection standards apply.

No problem at all! – here you will find more [frequently asked questions][70].

inSign has been on the market for over 15 years in [various sectors][48] and is used by well over 10

Excellent service: personalised and trustworthy

At inSign, we focus on real people rather than anonymous processes. Your personal point of contact
understands your needs, supports you and works with you to further develop our solution. This close
relationship shapes our collaboration right from the start.

High data protection standards

Our product is made in Germany with high standards of [data protection and legal compliance][49].

Digital sovereignty guaranteed

All data and all service providers involved are based in Germany; there is no reliance on US

## **FAQ** – Key issues about our digital signature

Are inSign electronic signatures legally compliant?

The electronic signature can be used for legal purposes in all European Union countries and cannot
be rejected as evidence. inSign supports the [signature types][62] simple electronic signature
(SES), advanced electronic signature (AES) and qualfied electronic signature (QES) in accordance
with both eIDAS and ZertES.

[More about legal and data protection][63]

What documents can be signed with inSign?

You can sign and fill in any kind of [PDF documents ][64]with our signature software. Whether
invoices, order confirmations or contracts – signing is easy thanks to inSign. With the inSign Word
Add-in, [ Word documents][65] can also be automatically converted into a PDF, making it very easy to
sign them electronically. The same is possible with the Excel add-in for Excel documents.

[Further use cases][66]

Can you sign directly on the computer?

Yes, with inSign signatures be made on the computer by means of keyboard input or qualified
certificate (QES).
For the handwritten electronic signature, a touch-sensitive screen (smartphone, tablet, etc.) is
required. If a computer does not have a touch screen, the signature process can be redirected to a
smartphone, for example.

[All about features and advantages of inSign][67]

Why can I use the electronic signature without worries?

inSign creates an audit report (transaction log) of the complete signature workflow. This, together
with the information depending on the signature method, serves as proof in the event of any
disputes. The evidential value of the biometric data in the handwritten signature of inSign was
examined by an qualified handwriting expert and positively assessed in an expert opinion. All inSign
signatures are GDPR and eIDAS compliant and 100% secure.

[More about advanced and qualified signature][68]

How does inSign ensure data sovereignty?
With the inSign electronic signature software, companies retain full control over their data at all
times. inSign is a German company and uses German subcontractors. Data processing takes place in
Germany in data centres operated by German companies. inSign guarantees full compliance with the
GDPR, meaning that the high European data protection standards apply.

No problem at all! – here you will find more [frequently asked questions][70].

## You ask, we answer

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

monitoring, forensics and incident response, cloud security, and leadership. Advancing your

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk,
and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

**Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM**
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained
innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust.

**Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™**
Validated directly by security practitioners for product capabilities, deployment experience, and
measurable operational value.

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises
and MSSPs.

[READ THE REPORT][167]

### Questions?

#### How does Signable work?

Sending online documents is straightforward with Signable using our reliable and trusted electronic
signature software. You just need to upload your document or use an existing template, then add the
signer and specify where you want them to sign.

Send the document over, and the signer will receive an email with a unique link to the document.
Signers can access the document from any device without having to sign up for A Signable account.

Once the document is signed you’ll receive a notification via email, and you can view or download
it.

#### Is Signable easy to set up?

It’s really straightforward to get started with Signable, and you’ll be sending documents to be
electronically signed in a matter of minutes. With Signable’s user-friendly e signature software you
can sign documents electronically in a matter of minutes, and we offer plenty of resources and
excellent customer support to help you get set up.

#### How does Signable keep documents secure?

As part of Signable’s trusted document signing software, we use SSL encryption to ensure that your
documents are kept safe.

When it comes to logging in, there’s a range of security features you can enable within your
account, such as two-factor authentication, or Single Sign-On (SSO).

A detailed audit log for each step of the signing process works to prevent fraudulent signing and
helps keep your documents secure. Plus, you can password protect documents so that only the people
you authorise can access them.

such as eIDAS, the ESIGN Act, UETA, and more, to ensure your documents are legally binding in any
court.

account.

in. And it’s really easy to sign on any device, whether they’re using a phone or desktop computer.

Using eSignatures can help you to streamline your business processes and workflows – helping you to
save time and save money. You won’t need to pay to print out and post physical copies of every
document to be signed. Signing documents online has never been easier, you can send them out
anytime, anywhere and get documents signed in moments.

You’ll see our plans talk about ‘Envelopes’ quite a lot at Signable. This is essentially like a
physical envelope, in which you can put a single document or multiple documents into, to send out to
your clients for signing.

An envelope can have both a mixture of uploaded documents and templates or just a template you’ve
already added to your Signable account. Find out more about [how to send an envelope here][46].

# Signature Generator

Signing your name on things isn’t as prevalent as it used to be. Few people use paper checks anymore
and most shops and restaurants don’t need you to sign a piece of paper with your bill. However,
digital signatures are still important for drafting documents and letters, especially legal
materials. They also are terrific for graphics on personal and business websites. But how do you
generate a digital version of your signature for these situations?

That’s where our signature generator tools come in! We have a pair of online tools that can help you
create a digital image of your actual hand-drawn signature or create a fully digital signature from
your typed name.

Regardless of which tool you use, they are totally free. You can use them as much as you like
without cost, there are no watermarks on your images, and you don’t need to register or enter your
email. We even offer multiple image formats, colors, line weights, and typefaces.

## Drawn Signature Generator

This tool is perfect if you already have a cool signature design. You can draw out your signature in
your personal style using your mouse, finger, or stylus, and our server will convert it into an
image. You can then save this image in various formats for adding to documents, websites, etc.

## Typed Signature Generator

If you don’t already have a great signature design for when you’re putting pen to paper, this tool
is what you need. Our server will use your typed name and create a professional-looking script
version. We do this by utilizing dozens of royalty-free typefaces, which allow you to find a
signature that matches your unique brand or style. Once designed, you can save it as an image and
paste it wherever needed.

from your existing software and hardware.  It’s how Silent Sector delivers the high level of
proficiency typically only available to large enterprises, right-sized for the budgets of mid-market
and emerging organizations who need it most.

## SutiSoft FAQs

Quick answers to what SutiSoft does, who it is for, and how it fits your stack.

What is SutiSoft?

SutiSoft is a connected business automation platform that brings finance, HR, sales, and agreements
together in one place. Each area runs as its own platform, but they share one login, one analytics
layer, and the same security and compliance controls, so teams that once needed several separate
tools can work from a single system.

What business processes can I automate with SutiSoft?

You can automate [spend management][124] across accounts payable, expense, and procurement, the
[agreement lifecycle][125] across eSignature, contract management, and document management, [human
resources][126] from hire to retire, and [customer relationship management][127] across marketing,
sales, and service. Most customers start with one platform and expand from there.

Is SutiSoft a single platform or separate products?

It is one connected platform. Every solution shares a single login and a common analytics layer, so
your data and reporting stay consistent across finance, HR, sales, and agreements instead of living
in disconnected systems.

Which teams is SutiSoft built for?

SutiSoft is used by finance and operations teams, along with HR, sales, and the legal or
administrative groups that manage agreements. Because the platforms connect, it suits organizations
that want one vendor and one system across several departments.

Does SutiSoft connect with the tools and ERP we already use?

Yes. SutiSoft fits into your existing stack, and accounts payable in particular syncs approved
invoice and payment data to your ERP, so finance teams are not re-keying information between
systems.

How does SutiSoft keep our data secure and compliant?

Security and compliance are built into the platform rather than bolted on. Access runs through a
single secure login across every solution, with the controls and audit visibility that finance, HR,
and legal teams expect.

How accurate is SutiSoft's accounts payable automation?

Our [accounts payable automation][128] pairs AI-driven invoice capture with an expert validation
step, so the information passed to your ERP is checked for accuracy before it posts. That means far
fewer manual corrections and a cleaner audit trail.

## SutiSoft FAQs

Quick answers to what SutiSoft does, who it is for, and how it fits your stack.

What is SutiSoft?

SutiSoft is a connected business automation platform that brings finance, HR, sales, and agreements
together in one place. Each area runs as its own platform, but they share one login, one analytics
layer, and the same security and compliance controls, so teams that once needed several separate
tools can work from a single system.

What business processes can I automate with SutiSoft?

You can automate [spend management][124] across accounts payable, expense, and procurement, the
[agreement lifecycle][125] across eSignature, contract management, and document management, [human
resources][126] from hire to retire, and [customer relationship management][127] across marketing,
sales, and service. Most customers start with one platform and expand from there.

Is SutiSoft a single platform or separate products?

It is one connected platform. Every solution shares a single login and a common analytics layer, so
your data and reporting stay consistent across finance, HR, sales, and agreements instead of living
in disconnected systems.

Which teams is SutiSoft built for?

SutiSoft is used by finance and operations teams, along with HR, sales, and the legal or
administrative groups that manage agreements. Because the platforms connect, it suits organizations
that want one vendor and one system across several departments.

Does SutiSoft connect with the tools and ERP we already use?

Yes. SutiSoft fits into your existing stack, and accounts payable in particular syncs approved
invoice and payment data to your ERP, so finance teams are not re-keying information between
systems.

How does SutiSoft keep our data secure and compliant?

Security and compliance are built into the platform rather than bolted on. Access runs through a
single secure login across every solution, with the controls and audit visibility that finance, HR,
and legal teams expect.

How accurate is SutiSoft's accounts payable automation?

Our [accounts payable automation][128] pairs AI-driven invoice capture with an expert validation
step, so the information passed to your ERP is checked for accuracy before it posts. That means far
fewer manual corrections and a cleaner audit trail.
